title: Bridging / Carrying Channel
descHtml: DASS bridging channels are used for stiffening steel stud walls both non-loadbearing and loadbearing walls and partitions. The channel is turned to lock it into place within the stud knockout in order to provide resistance to twisting of the steel stud due to wind or axial loading. The bridging channel is also the preferred way of installing a drywall ceiling with furring channel connected perpendicular to the bridging channel suspended from the structure above.

title: Deflection Side Clip
descHtml:
Deflection Clips serve as crucial components for both exterior curtain walls and interior studs. Their primary purpose is to accommodate building structure deflection at the top of the wall. Moreover, they are versatile and suitable for non-load-bearing applications.

DC 3.50 or DC 5.87 Deflection Clip offers multiple attachment methods to the structure. title: Furring Channel
descHtml:
The drywall furring channel is a versatile ‘hat-shaped’ section with a wide range of applications. It is primarily used to connect your finished wall material to the underlying framework, providing structural support. Furring is commonly attached perpendicularly to bridging channels and serves as the base to which drywall is subsequently secured. It’s the preferred method for constructing drywall ceilings as well. In scenarios involving concrete surfaces, furring is typically used to fasten drywall securely. Additionally, it finds application in situations such as metal siding, where it is horizontally affixed to the structure and then acts as a foundation for the siding material.

To effectively reduce structure-borne sound transmission and maximize the usable space in soundproof rooms, drywall furring hat channels are an excellent solution. Galvanized steel hat channels designed for drywall applications can be seamlessly incorporated into drop ceilings or walls. The availability of steel channels in heavier gauges allows for increased loading capacity. Steel channels are renowned for their resilience, reliability, and structural integrity, making them the ideal choice for construction projects. For optimal results in constructing a drywall ceiling, a combination of cold-rolled channels and furring channels is recommended.

For a secure and long-lasting bonding option on your ceiling or walls, steel is the ideal choice. It is galvanized to ensure protection against corrosion and fire hazards, offering a high level of safety. Additionally, steel channels are straightforward to install, adding to their convenience.
excerpt: The drywall furring channel is a versatile ‘hat-shaped’ section with a wide range of applications.
seoDescription: Furring Channel is used to provide a means to connect your finished wall product to the structure behind it.

title: J Track
descHtml: The J-Track plays a crucial role in shaftwall assemblies, serving as the floor and ceiling component. CT/CH studs and gypsum shaft liner panels are snugly fitted between the top and bottom J-Track sections. These tracks feature unequal legs, with the longer leg (offered in 2-1/4″ and 3″) installed against the shaft. This longer leg acts as a backstop, simplifying the installation of the liner panel. The 3-inch leg track is commonly used as a jamb strut for various closure details, including duct and door openings, abutments, and intersections.

title: J Trim
descHtml:
J Bead Trims are reveal-style galvanised steel casings that are strong and give drywall terminations around door and window openings the maximum amount of protection and neatly finished edges. At junctions or where gypsum panels about contrasting surfaces like columns and window mullions, Drywall J Trims provide a neat trim line. Hemmed edges make installation quick and don’t need joint compound to finish.

Dass Metal’s short leg J Bead Trim is a clean, secure, and smooth edge, and both legs are angled for a firm hold on sheathing made of gypsum or another material. The outer edge of the long leg has a minor level for a smooth, snug fit, and the base of the long leg has a slight rib that serves as a screed for any finishes that are applied.

Used as a terminal at the junctions of wallboard and other surfaces, channel-type J trim offers a tidy protective edge for wallboard at windows and doors. J Bead Trims are metal trim attachments that have a variety of functions, including protecting the free edges of gypsum wallboards that range in thickness from 1/2″ to 5/8″.

title: L Track
descHtml:
L-track is one of those things whose importance you don’t fully appreciate until you need it. Once you’ve used it, you’ll see that there are many different methods to use L-track as a flatbed driver. L Track is a light gauge galvanized steel utility angle used in various applications such as column framing, bulkheads, etc. We have a variety of L-track systems with hooks, tacks, fittings, and other accessories because we are aware of how useful they are. Although 1 x 2 is the most typical size, DASS can make angles in almost any size and gauge to fit your needs.

This universal light-duty steel L track fitting can be used with any kind or style of aluminum load track. Almost any item can be attached to the aluminum tracker using the fitting. You can relocate the component wherever you want along the track by simply drilling a hole in the component you desire to attach.

For light loads that don’t need conventional winches and tie-downs, L-track is the best option. It is simple to install and use and incredibly efficient. We probably have just what you’re searching for if you’re looking for L-track. The same high standards that we maintain in our other products are also maintained in all of our L-track stud fitting items.
excerpt: L-track is one of those things whose importance you don’t fully appreciate until you need it.
seoDescription: L-Track is a light gauge galvanized steel utility angle used in various applications such as column framing, bulkheads, etc.

title: Resilient Channel
descHtml:
Resilient channels can be utilized in any application where sound transmission is an issue, but they are frequently used in multi-family housing developments, particularly those with wood frame construction. One of the most effective low-cost techniques designed to lessen airborne sound transmission via partition and ceiling assemblies is using resilient channels from Dass Metal.

As more and more multi-occupancy buildings are constructed, sound transmission (STC) has become a more important consideration in wall and ceiling design than ever before. When used on walls or ceilings, DASS resilient channel home depot significantly raises STC ratings. By suspending the gypsum wallboard 1/2″ from the stud or joist, the resilient channel stops sound waves effectively, dispersing the energy and minimizing sound transmission.

Your project’s metal or wood framing will obtain a more excellent STC rating thanks to resilient channel ceiling detail. Sound attenuation blankets placed into the wall or floor cavity can increase sound absorption.

RC Channel Features

  • Separates the plasterboard from the joists and studs, thus offering insulation against sound.
  • Low cost
  • Add 3-5 dB more insulation.
  • It is lightweight (just 1.2 kg), making it simple to operate.
  • Simple cutting with snips or a grinder is possible.
  • Its slotted Holes reduce flanking noise.
excerpt: Resilient channels can be utilized in any application where sound transmission is an issue, but they are frequently used in multi-family housing developments,…
seoDescription: A resilient channel that is designed to substantially improve the sound insulation of drywall, sheetrock, plasterboard walls and ceilings.

title: Shaftwall / Ch Stud
descHtml:
CH Studs / Shaftwallare robust, high-performance components meticulously designed to uphold the integrity of shaftwalls. These Ch Studs are specifically engineered for use with 1″ thick gypsum shaftliner panels, fitting snugly between top and bottom J Track sections. The gypsum shaftliner panels are effortlessly inserted into the stud flanges, creating an airtight friction fit along the panel’s length. The studs are automatically spaced at a maximum of 24″ o.c. To achieve the designated fire rating, the system is completed with fire-rated gypsum board.

Shaftwall systems are integral interior non-load-bearing wall assemblies, engineered to deliver essential fire-rated protection for elevator shafts, stairwells, vertical chases, and mechanical enclosures.

CH Studs are available in two thickness options: 22mils (25ga), and 33mils (20ga)
excerpt: CH Studs / Shaftwallare robust, high-performance components meticulously designed to uphold the integrity of shaftwalls.
seoDescription: CH Studs / Shaftwallare robust, high-performance components meticulously designed to uphold the integrity of shaftwalls.

title: Welded Wire Mesh
descHtml:
Welded Wire Mesh serve as reinforcement for concrete and are alternatively referred to as reinforcing welded wire mesh. Constructed from metal rods ranging in diameter from 3 to 40 inches, these rods are arranged parallel to each other, with another set of parallel rods placed on top. These rods are interconnected through welding to form a mesh sheet, with the shape of the openings varying between square and rectangular based on the intended application.

Galvanized steel mesh sheets are offered as well, boasting resistance against corrosion and rust. Their threaded structure not only improves adhesion to concrete but also reduces the occurrence of concrete cracks. Primarily employed in reinforcing foundations, road surfaces, bridges, and similar structures, mesh sheets play a significant role in enhancing their durability and strength.
excerpt: Welded Wire Mesh serve as reinforcement for concrete and are alternatively referred to as reinforcing welded wire mesh.
